# Light Water Capital

> Private capital management and family office based in Corydon, Indiana.

Light Water Capital is a private investment firm that manages capital for a select number of clients with a long-term, conviction-based approach. We combine quantitative research with fundamental judgment. We focus on public equities and quantitative strategies, building concentrated positions where we have high conviction.

## Pages

- Home: https://lightwaterdispatch.com/
- The Dispatch (blog): https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/

## Recent Articles

- [Nineteen Years: The 30-Year Treasury Makes a New Post-2007 High](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/thirty-year-treasury-2007-high-august-2026/) - August 2026. The 30-year Treasury yield topped 5.33% on 18 August, its highest since 2007, while the two-year fell to 4.18%. A bear steepener is a term-premium repricing, not a Fed repricing: covers the two components of a long yield, the supply arithmetic behind a ~$2.1 trillion projected FY2026 deficit, the 13 August 30-year auction clearing at 5.216%, AI hyperscaler bond issuance competing for long-duration capital, and the duration math that makes a "safe" long bond move like an equity.
- [The Clean Print: What July Core CPI Does - and Does Not - Change](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/the-clean-print-july-core-cpi-2026/) - August 2026. Core CPI cooled to 2.5% year over year and headline to 3.4%, but the print merely matched consensus. Covers the composition beneath the headline - shelter finally restrained at 0.1%, a mixed rather than broad-based core services basket, motor-vehicle insurance rolling over - and why an energy index still 14.7% higher than a year ago keeps this from being a regime change. Better is not the same as finished.
- [Boring Wins: DCA vs. Buying the Dip](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/boring-wins-dca-vs-buying-the-dip/) - August 2026. A popular rule says hold cash, wait for the Nasdaq to fall 10%, then buy your favorite names. Backtested on QQQ from 1999 to today: the bounce after a 10% dip is real at three and six months, but a standing weekly buy that never looks finished with roughly twice the wealth. The dip-buyer sat in cash 96% of the time. Also covers the survivorship trap in "your favorite stocks" - the index self-cleans, a single speculative name does not. By Zach Smith.
- [We Ran 60 Backtests on One Strategy. The Win Rate Never Beat a Coin Flip.](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/forex-ema-breakout-strategy-teardown/) - July 2026. A 50-EMA New York session breakout on EURUSD, GBPUSD and XAUUSD, tested across 16.5 years of hourly data and roughly 60 configurations - none with a real edge. Covers comparing win rate against the 1/(1+RR) breakeven instead of zero, separating gross from net expectancy to tell a cost problem from a signal problem, why higher-timeframe trend and volume filters made it worse, the "fewer trades looks better" trap, and a structural-stop bug that produced a single &minus;168R loss and negative equity. By Zach Smith and Shardul Mehetar. Full tearsheet PDFs available as downloads.
- [Warsh Draws the Line: Reading the July FOMC](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/warsh-fomc-july-2026/) - July 2026. The Fed held at 3.50–3.75% on a 9–3 vote with all three dissenters wanting a hike, and Chair Kevin Warsh said this Fed "will not waver." The tell was the bond market: the Dow fell roughly 1,100 points while long Treasuries sold off rather than rallied, pushing the 30-year yield to its highest since 2007. Falling stocks plus falling bonds is an inflationary, higher-for-longer repricing - not a growth scare - and it explains why long-duration growth was punished while energy was the only green sector.
- [We Built a Trading Strategy Live. The First Result Was a +444% Mirage.](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/rsi-divergence-strategy-livestream/) - July 2026. A live-built RSI/price-divergence strategy on the Nasdaq 100 that first showed +444% and passed Monte Carlo and walk-forward checks - before we found it was almost entirely two stock-split data artifacts. A teardown of how a backtest lies before it tells the truth: split adjustment, Monte Carlo blind spots, winner-concentration testing, and the search for a real edge. By Zach Smith and Shardul Mehetar. Full tearsheet PDFs available as downloads.
- [Supply Scare, Demand Reality: Market Memorandum July 2026](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/market-memorandum-july-2026/) - July 2026. The Iran ceasefire collapsed and crude spiked, but equities shrugged. A cross-asset read on the Strait of Hormuz supply shock, the Strategic Petroleum Reserve at a 40-year low, and the weakening demand picture capping the price.
- [Welcoming Our New Quantitative Strategy Intern](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/shardul-mehetar-intern-announcement/) - July 2026. Shardul Mehetar, an MS Data Science candidate at the University of Delaware, joins Light Water's Systematic Strategies team as a Quantitative Strategy Intern.
- [Cross-Asset Divergences: Market Memorandum May 2026](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/market-memorandum-may-2026/) - May 2026. The equity market is pricing in a soft landing. Credit, banks, and commodities are not. A cross-asset read on SPY, oil, copper, credit, and the stagflation risk building beneath the surface. Full memorandum available as PDF download.
- [Alpha Sprint: Intern Coverage Initiations on $COIN and $NVDA](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/alpha-sprint-coverage-initiation/) - April 2026. Chang Liu initiates Coinbase at Hold and Alice Li initiates Nvidia at Hold as the first research output of Light Water's 12-week Alpha Sprint program.
- [Alpha Sprint: First Monthly Update on $COIN and $NVDA](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/alpha-sprint-coverage-update-april/) - April 2026. Chang Liu maintains Coinbase at Hold ahead of May 7 earnings; Alice Li maintains Nvidia at Hold ahead of May 20. Two names, two distinct headwinds, two earnings prints in three weeks.
- [We're Looking for a Mentor for Our Alpha Sprint Interns](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/alpha-sprint-mentor-call/) - April 2026. An open call for an experienced quantitative strategist willing to share their journey with the interns in Light Water's 12-week Alpha Sprint program.
- [We Let AI Iterate on a Trading Strategy for 20 Minutes](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/ai-autoresearch-trading-strategy-backtesting/) - March 2026. Applying Karpathy's autoresearch loop to quantitative strategy development - 30 autonomous experiments, zero human intervention. AI improved returns from 133.8% to 290.6%.
- [Why We Open-Sourced Our Trading Backtester](https://lightwaterdispatch.com/dispatch/july-backtester/) - March 2026. The story behind July Backtester, our open-source Python backtesting engine with Monte Carlo simulation, walk-forward analysis, and regime detection.

## Investment Philosophy

- Concentration over diversification: fewer, deeply researched positions
- Quantitative rigor: every thesis tested against data
- Long time horizons: underwriting investments over years, not quarters
- Aligned incentives: firm capital invested alongside clients

## Open Source

- July Backtester: https://github.com/zachisit/july-backtester - Professional-grade Python backtesting engine with Monte Carlo, walk-forward analysis, parameter sensitivity, and regime detection. MIT licensed.
